hybrid_application_shell.pattern: Svelte single-page UI inside a Tauri 2 host
hybrid_application_shell.summary: The TypeScript entry installs the IPC seam, initializes persisted UI stores, and mounts App; the Rust library builds the native host and registers invoke commands.

transport_neutral_host_adapter.pattern: One engine behind Tauri and headless WebSocket adapters
transport_neutral_host_adapter.summary: Host abstracts event emission and state access; the optional server exposes invoke, response, and event frames to the same frontend through an early-installed shim.

centralized_frontend_state.pattern: Module-level Svelte 5 rune stores with typed tab routing
centralized_frontend_state.summary: The app store owns tabs, sessions, navigation, preferences, and backend loaders; AppShell renders panes by tab type and keeps SFTP, transfer, and AI surfaces connected to the same session registry.

session_scoped_ipc.pattern: Command requests plus session-scoped event channels
session_scoped_ipc.summary: Frontend invoke calls cross the command boundary, while terminal, authentication, transfer, and AI streams use event names suffixed with a session, transfer, or tab identifier.

multi_transport_terminal.pattern: A shared xterm pane over transport-specific backend sessions
multi_transport_terminal.summary: TerminalPane selects SSH, local PTY, serial, Telnet, Docker exec, or kubectl exec command and event contracts; backend state retains the live handles.

shared_sqlite_persistence.pattern: SQLite repositories shared by GUI, CLI, and headless server
shared_sqlite_persistence.summary: Db opens the common data directory with WAL, foreign keys, migrations, and a busy timeout; domain modules mediate persisted records for every host surface.

encrypted_secret_abstraction.pattern: SecretStore envelope encryption with platform-selected master-key backend
encrypted_secret_abstraction.summary: Callers use one SecretStore abstraction; encrypted values are kept behind HybridStore while the master-key backend is selected and retained consistently for GUI, server, and CLI use.

ai_actor_and_approval_loop.pattern: Backend diagnosis actor with frontend command approval
ai_actor_and_approval_loop.summary: The frontend AI store starts and resumes sessions, consumes per-tab events, and returns approved command outcomes; the Rust actor applies tool schemas, sanitization, audit, and provider clients.

sftp_background_transfers.pattern: Session-bound browsing plus independent background transfer handles
sftp_background_transfers.summary: The browser can attach SFTP to an SSH session, while the transfer store tracks independent jobs through per-transfer progress events and cancellation handles.

multi_surface_binaries.pattern: Shared Rust library delivered as GUI, CLI, headless server, and IDE tool window
multi_surface_binaries.summary: Cargo declares three binaries over rssh_lib; the IntelliJ plugin starts the server and hosts the same web frontend in JCEF.

platform_gating.pattern: Compile-time native gating plus frontend mobile routing
platform_gating.summary: Rust cfg attributes exclude desktop-only PTY, serial, clipboard, and window behavior where unsupported; the frontend uses the central isMobile flag for mobile interaction paths.

encrypted_configuration_sync.pattern: Shared export/import model with encrypted remote adapters
encrypted_configuration_sync.summary: GUI and CLI call the same configuration payload and merge logic; GitHub and WebDAV adapters transport the encrypted representation.

layered_test_strategy.pattern: Vitest for frontend logic and Rust module tests for native behavior
layered_test_strategy.summary: Vitest transforms Svelte rune modules in a Node environment, while Rust modules use the built-in test harness and isolated database helpers.
